newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Press in Chinese magazines JV.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Press in Chinese magazines JV.

text.p: Singapore Press Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its unit Lianhe Publishing Pte Ltd agreed a joint venture with Burda-Rizzoli (Asia) Holdings Ltd (BR) to publish and distribute Chinese-language magazines for the Taiwan, Hong Kong and China markets.

The company, which holds a monopoly of newspaper publishing in Singapore, said in a statement that Lianhe would hold 51 percent of the new venture, Asia Century Publishing Pte Ltd, with BR holding the rest.
The paid-up capital of Asia Century would be set at Singapore $1.4 million, it said.
